name: Beef and Potato Keema
summary: Spiced ground beef with potato and peas, served over rice. A cheap curry.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook 4 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook 6–7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the garlic and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the diced potato, diced tomatoes, and 250 mL water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in the frozen vegetables and cook 4 minutes more. Season with salt.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. Check any pre-mixed curry powder for wheat-based fillers.

budgetNotes: Potato and frozen vegetables stretch a small amount of beef across four plates.
Ground turkey or pork works too.
Make it hotter with a pinch of cayenne or chili flakes.
